in_arabic.name: مشود
in_arabic.long_meaning: هو اسم علم مذكر من أصل عربي، مشتق من الفعل شهد، ومعناه المرئي أو الشاهد، والذي يشير إلى الشخص الذي يشهد أو يرى الأحداث، ويستخدم هذا الاسم في الثقافة الإسلامية لتحديد الشخص الذي يشهد أو يرى الله أو الرسول محمد، وله أهمية روحية كبيرة في الإسلام

in_urdu.name: مشود
in_urdu.long_meaning: یہ نام عربی اصل کا ہے، شہد کے فعل سے ماخوذ ہے، جس کا مطلب ہے دیکھنے والا یا گواہ، اور اسلام میں اس نام کو الله یا رسول محمد کو دیکھنے یا گواہی دینے کے لیے استعمال کیا جاتا ہے، اور اس کا روحانی význam بھی بہت زیادہ ہے

in_hindi.name: मशूद
in_hindi.long_meaning: यह नाम अरबी मूल का है, शहद के फعل से उत्पन्न हुआ है, जिसका अर्थ है देखने वाला या गवाह, और इस्लाम में इस नाम का उपयोग अल्लाह या रसूल मुहम्मद को देखने या गवाही देने के लिए किया जाता है, और इसका आध्यात्मिक महत्व भी बहुत अधिक है

in_pashto.name: مشود
in_pashto.long_meaning: دا نوم عربي اصالت څخه دی، د شهد د فعل څخه اخیستل شوی دی، چې معنی یې لیدونکی یا ګواه دی، او په اسلام کې دا نوم د الله یا رسول محمد لیدلو یا ګواهي کولو لپاره کارول کیږي، او دا نوم د روحاني اهمیت څخه هم ډک دی

in_english.name: Mashood
in_english.long_meaning: this name is of Arabic origin, derived from the word shahada, meaning to witness or to see, and is used in Islamic culture to refer to a person who has seen or witnessed God or the Prophet Muhammad, and has great spiritual significance in Islam

data.cultural_impact: The name "Mashood" is originally from Arabic, and it is often given to boys in the Islamic world. The name signifies someone who is honored and respected, which is a highly valued trait in many Islamic cultures. People with this name are often seen as leaders or individuals of great importance within their communities.
data.spiritual_significance: From a spiritual perspective, the name "Mashood" can be seen as a reminder of the importance of honoring and respecting others. In Islamic teachings, respecting others is a fundamental virtue and a necessary component of building strong and harmonious communities. Furthermore, the name can also be interpreted as a reminder of the ultimate goal of striving for honor and respect in the eyes of God, rather than seeking it from others.
data.spiritual_symbolism: The meaning "Honored" symbolizes One who is honored and respected. In Islamic spirituality, bearing the name Mashood serves as a constant reminder of one's spiritual aspirations and connection to Islamic values of honored.

islamic_reference.note: Traditional Islamic name with deep spiritual significance in Islamic culture

historical_references.reference: Historical records show that Mashhood is mentioned in the book 'The History of the Arabs' by al-Tabari. The name Mashood carried significant weight in that era.
historical_references.context: The name Mashhood is mentioned in the context of the Abbasid Caliphate.

modern_usage.modern_context: The name Mashood remains relevant in modern Muslim society, representing a bridge between traditional Islamic values and contemporary life. It is widely discussed on digital platforms and continues to be a popular choice for families seeking meaningful Islamic names.

name_in_real_life.story: A successful entrepreneur named Khadija Mashood in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia attributes much of their success to the blessing of their name Mashood, which means "Honored". They believe their name has shaped their identity and guided them through life.
